blocks.x: As the air gets colder here in New York, the idea of a tropical getaway feels more and more enticing by the day. And while we love our tiny neighbors all across the city, sometimes the idea of an adults-only vacation where guests can really relax is just what the doctor ordered for a seasonal refresh.

Luckily, two major travel brands are making that dream a reality. JetBlue Vacations and Virgin Voyages are teaming up for a first-of-its-kind getaway that brings the adults-only experience to every step of the journey, from takeoff to sail away. That means no little ones on the flight, no kids on the cruise, and plenty of opportunities to kick back and enjoy some well-deserved time off.

Aptly named “Do Not Disturb: A Getaway Reserved for Grown-Ups,” the exclusive package includes round-trip flights from New York’s JFK Airport to Fort Lauderdale, private transportation to PortMiami, and a four-night Virgin Voyages cruise aboard the Brilliant Lady. Departing March 4, 2027, the tropical escape includes stops in Key West and Bimini, where turquoise waters, beachside lounging, and a little Caribbean sunshine await.
So, if your idea of paradise involves a piña colada, uninterrupted relaxation, and absolutely nowhere you need to be, this might just be the escape you’ve been waiting for.

Unsplash / Nick Morales
What to Know: The Flight Experience

The adults-only treatment starts long before you step foot onto the ship. The “Do Not Disturb” journey begins at New York’s JFK Airport, where select travelers will enjoy first-come, first-served access to BlueHouse, JetBlue’s distinctly New York take on the airport lounge.

Once onboard your dedicated JetBlue flight from JFK to Fort Lauderdale (FLL), you won’t hear kicking seats or calls of “Are we there yet?” Instead, Virgin Voyages is kicking off the trip with a complimentary in-flight toast to celebrate the start of your kid-free getaway.
Upon landing in Florida, seamless private round-trip transfers will carry you straight to PortMiami—with your luggage fully handled, leaving you with nothing to do but relax and enjoy the ride.

Shutterstock / NextNewMedia
What to Know: The Cruise & Onboard Perks

Once at PortMiami, you’ll breeze through the terminal with priority boarding through Virgin Voyages’ exclusive RockStar entrance and lounge. You’ll then step aboard Virgin Voyages’ glamorous new vessel, Brilliant Lady, for a four-night Caribbean escape (March 4–8, 2027).
The itinerary balances laid-back island charm with high-end luxury:
Key West, Florida: Where “it’s five o’clock somewhere” actually means something, perfect for strolls through historic streets and dockside cocktails.
The Beach Club at Bimini, Bahamas: Virgin’s private oasis where turquoise waters and swaying palms meet the energy of a Mediterranean day club—completely free of cannonball contests or splash zones.

Onboard Brilliant Lady, guests will enjoy over 20 made-to-order eateries led by Michelin-star culinary talent, immersive entertainment, and state-of-the-art thermal suites. Plus, every package comes loaded with exclusive VIP add-ons:
A private onboard Welcome Party featuring a signature “Do Not Disturb” cocktail.
A $100 Bar Tab per cabin to spend on premium drinks and crafted cocktails.
Exclusive in-cabin surprise & delight gifts throughout the voyage.
A chance to win one of 10 special $50 onboard credits toward mud baths in the Thermal Suite, Shore Things excursions, or extra perks.

Source / Virgin Voyages
How to Book Tickets
Because this is a one-time-only event, availability is extremely limited. Only 60 cabins are available on a strict first-come, first-served basis.
Price: $2,750 for two adults (includes round-trip flights, transfers, the four-night cruise, taxes, fees, gratuities, and VIP extras).
On-Sale Date: Bookings open Wednesday, October 21, at 12:00 PM (noon) EDT.
How to Book: Visit jetbluevacations.com/trip-ideas/do-not-disturb or call JetBlue Vacations directly at 1-844-528-2229.
Don’t miss out! Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and now on WhatsApp, too!
